hints.title: Identify Extrema
hints.text: Find the absolute minimum and maximum values present in the array.

hints.title: Strict Inequality Condition
hints.text: An element has both a strictly smaller and strictly greater element if and only if it is strictly greater than the minimum and strictly smaller than the maximum.

hints.title: Count Satisfying Elements
hints.text: Count how many elements in the array fall strictly between min and max.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every element against all others takes O(N^2) pairwise comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Finding extrema and filtering takes O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Avoid full sorting when extrema bounds suffice.
